name: writehand
description: Create and retrieve brand-aware blog posts and landing pages from a structured brief.

interface.longDescription: Writehand: Blog Generator & AI Writing Assistant is a writing productivity tool for blogs, landing pages, and content refreshes. Prepare a structured brief using your topic, audience, brand context, keywords, and goals. Review and confirm the brief before requesting generation. Track your jobs and retrieve completed draft articles, separate technical SEO variants, cover images, downloads, and editorial review notes. Requires a connected Writehand account. Review every draft and its supporting evidence before publication; search rankings and factual accuracy are not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Create a blog post about onboarding for SaaS teams.
Prepare a landing page brief for my product.
Refresh my existing blog post for its primary keyword.

review.commerce_description: Existing paid Writehand accounts use generation credits. Credits and subscriptions are purchased externally through Paddle on the Writehand website. No purchases or checkout are offered inside the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Sign-in reliability improvements: reuse valid website sessions, provide explicit account switching, limit repeated email requests, and reserve free sending capacity for returning accounts. Updated provider/privacy information and direct ChatGPT installation guidance. Existing content generation, account ownership, credits and tools are unchanged. First-party OAuth discovery is preferred while legacy tokens remain supported; the saved public connection configuration must be verified separately.
